title: Customer Renewal Signal Catalog & Prioritization Worksheet
content:
Purpose:
This working worksheet defines a compact set of observable signals and a reproducible scoring formula to prioritize QBR cadence and renewal outreach. Intended for CS managers, AMs, and CSMs running weekly renewal review huddles. Keep this lightweight: it should map to sources we already have in the data warehouse and the Console metrics panel.

How to use: 
- Run the score generator weekly for the cohort (customers with contracts expiring within 180 days).
- Sort by Priority bucket, then ARR, then contract date for outreach scheduling.
- Attach last 3 months of usage charts and any open SRE/Support tickets to the QBR packet.

Scoring signals (observable, boolean/continuous):
1) Contract ARR band (input: MRR/ARR) — 0..20 points
   - <100k: 4 pts, 100–500k: 10 pts, 500k–2M: 15 pts, >2M: 20 pts
2) ICP Fit (qualitative mapped to numeric) — 0..15 points
   - Core ICP: 15, Adjacent ICP: 8, Out-of-ICP: 0
3) Deployment Mode (hosted | dedicated | private) — 0..12 points
   - Private (on-prem/VPC): 12, Dedicated: 8, Hosted: 4
4) Region strategic priority — 0..8 points
   - NA/EU top priority markets: 8, APAC growth: 6, Other: 2
5) Usage trend (3mo token trend, normalized) — -10..15 points
   - >+25% growth: +15, +5–25%: +8, flat (-5..+5%): 0, -5–-25%: -6, <-25%: -10
6) SLO/incident signals (last 90d) — -15..0 points
   - >3 Sev2+/ongoing incident: -15, 1–3 incidents: -8, 0 incidents: 0
7) Latency degradation (p50/p95 change) — -8..0 points
   - p95 regressed >50% vs baseline: -8, 10–50%: -4, <10%: 0
8) Evaluation/quality regressions (failures on saved promptset) — -10..0 points
   - >=2 regressions flagged: -10, 1 regression: -5, 0: 0
9) Strategic dependency (embedded feature adoption / roadmap reliance) — 0..12 points
   - Uses critical product integrations (e.g., fine-tuning, private metrics): 12, minor integration: 6, none: 0
10) Legal/compliance friction (contract clauses, PoCs with regulated data) — -10..0 points
   - Active compliance blocker: -10, in-review: -4, none: 0
11) Time to renewal (days to expiry) — 0..10 points (urgency multiplier)
   - <30d: 10, 30–90d: 6, 90–180d: 3, >180d: 0

Weights & formula (example):
NormalizedScore = sum(signal_points). Cap to -20..100 then normalize to 0..100 for presentation. Suggested absolute thresholds:
- High priority (outreach this week): normalized >= 70
- Medium (monitor, prep QBR): 40–69
- Low (standard renewal cadence): <40

Example computed rows (sample preview that would live in the sheet):
- Acme Analytics | ARR 1.2M | ICP: Core | Deployment: Dedicated | Region: NA | 3mo usage +32% | 0 incidents | p95 stable | Uses finetune | expiry 46d => Raw score 82 => Priority: High
- BrightRetail | ARR 220k | ICP: Adjacent | Hosted | EU | usage -12% | 1 Sev2 | p95 +18% | no key integration | expiry 120d => Raw score 53 => Priority: Medium
- SmallCo Labs | ARR 45k | Out-of-ICP | Hosted | APAC | usage flat | 0 incidents | expiry 240d => Raw score 18 => Priority: Low

Playbook mapping by Priority bucket (playbook recipes, actions and owners):
High priority (>=70) — immediate outbound + executive escalation
- Owner: CSM + AM; timeline: Outreach within 48 hours
- Actions: 1) Set renewal scoping call, 2) Pull product health + regression logs + top 5 slow traces, 3) Prepare customized cost/perf proposal (Dedicated/Private options if cost-sensitive), 4) Schedule exec intro (Sales Director / Solutions Eng) if ARR >500k, 5) Open renewal opportunity in CRM with next steps and engagement plan
- Trigger add-ons: Solutions Eng deep-dive (if private/dedicated), Legal kickoff if compliance mention

Medium priority (40–69) — nurture + QBR prep
- Owner: CSM; timeline: Outreach within 7–10 days
- Actions: 1) Prepare QBR packet with usage trend + ROI notes, 2) Identify potential upsell levers (Optimize suggestions: quantization, batching), 3) Run targeted evals for any quality concerns, 4) Monitor for incident recurrence

Low priority (<40) — standard cadence, efficiency-focused
- Owner: CS Operations; timeline: Standard renewal play (30–60d pre-expiry reminders)
- Actions: 1) Automated renewal reminders, 2) Light QBR template, 3) Enrollment in product newsletter / best-practice doc set

QBR talking points (short templates by bucket):
- High: "Usage growth has accelerated X% and you're approaching [feature] adoption — here's a recommended plan to preserve latency SLOs while reducing unit cost. We suggest a dedicated capacity pilot and exec alignment to secure roadmap support."
- Medium: "We see stable engagement but a small dip in tokens; let's surface cost/quality levers and run a short eval to confirm no model drift."
- Low: "Usage is stable/low. We'll maintain standard support and revisit at renewal window; consider Evergreen documentation and best practices."

Data sources & example queries (keepsheet of fields to include in automation):
- Console usage exports: monthly_token_count (metric), active_users_7d, embeddings_requests
- Datadog/SRE: sev_count_90d, avg_p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct
- Billing: ARR, payment_status, contract_start, contract_end
- Quality: eval_failures_last_30d (from evaluation pipeline), promptset_pass_rate
- CRM: account_owner, opportunity_stage, last_contact_date

Sample SQL-ish pseudo queries (replace table names):
- 3mo token trend: SELECT account_id, (sum(tokens) - lag(sum(tokens),1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id))/lag(sum(tokens),1) as pct_change FROM tokens_per_month WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '3 months') GROUP BY account_id
- Sev2 count: SELECT account_id, count(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity >= 2 AND created_at >= current_date - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id

Pre-QBR owner checklist (quick):
- [ ] Verify score computed and attach chart of last 90d tokens
- [ ] Pull last 3 support incidents and remediation notes
- [ ] Confirm contract terms and legal clauses (privacy/regulatory)
- [ ] Prepare 2 tailored mitigation options (cost, dedicated/private, model tuning)
- [ ] Add stakeholders and confirm meeting time

Open items / debate notes (working):
- We need to decide whether negative signals (incidents, quality regressions) should be multiplicative vs additive for ARR-heavy customers; currently additive but can under-prioritize at-risk large accounts.
- Consider adding "strategic partner" boolean (1/0) to force-priority for co-sell agreements.
- Evaluate automating 'priority' tag in CRM via nightly job feeding normalized scores.

Version history / provenance:
- v0.1 initial draft (PRiya) 2024-09-12
- v0.2 adjustments to weights after renewal-warroom 2024-10-03 (Evan, Liam)
- v0.3 added quality regression signals 2024-11-03 (Sofia)

Next steps (action items):
- Owner (Priya) to push scoring SQL to analytics repo and prototype dashboard (due 2024-11-15).
- CS Ops (Jordan) to map score -> CRM tag and test on 50 accounts (due 2024-11-22).
- Run a manual review of all accounts expiring in next 90 days using this sheet for the Nov renewal cadence.

Notes to reviewer: This is intentionally prescriptive but lightweight — keep feedback focused on signal reliability and automation effort.
